source.text: [Congressional Bills 119th Congress] [From the U.S. Government Publishing Office] [H. Res. 1142 Engrossed in House (EH)] <DOC> H. Res. 1142 In the House of Representatives, U. S., March 27, 2026. Resolved, That upon adoption of this resolution, the House shall be considered to have taken from the Speaker's table the bill (H.R. 7147) making further consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and for other purposes, with the Senate amendment thereto, and to have concurred in the Senate amendment with an amendment consisting of the text of Rules Committee Print 119-21. Attest: Clerk.
